title.narrative: Strengthening Inclusive Social Cohesion and Livelihoods for Sustainable Peace in Burundi

description.narrative: The project aims at implementing recommendations of the UNPBF research on the root causes of gender norms and cultural practices that hinder women participation. The study was conducted by the University of Burundi in Ruyigi and Rutana provinces that have the same realities as Rumonge, the recommended area of implementation of this project. During the research validation process, the research team concluded that more efforts should be made at community level to build social cohesion, combat extreme poverty and exclusion in communities if women participation is to be effective. It is therefore expected that this project will consider the acute need that IDPs, returnees and community residents are confronted with in Rumonge and implement appropriate approaches that will result in new and revived capacity of communities to effectively manage and prevent the identified migration-related tensions. This project will particularly address the limited inclusion and participation of women, and particularly women from marginalized groups i.e. (IDPs and returnees), at zone and conseils collinaires levels. This further aligns with the National Plan for the Development of Burundi 2018-2027 in terms of gender and promotion of family cohesion, supporting the governments’ commitment to eliminating gender-related inequalities and exclusion recognizing that challenges persist. The National Programme for the Capitalization of Peace, Social Stability, and the Promotion of Economic Growth (2021‒2027) (PNCP-SS-PCE), which promotes integral rural development, with relevance to Pillar 2: Accelerating the Sustainable Reintegration and Resettlement of Vulnerable Populations.
